errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer with the given customer_id does not exist.

errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category with the given category_id does not exist.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product with the given product_id does not exist.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order with the given order_id does not exist.

errors.name: OrderItemNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order item with the given order_item_id does not exist.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an order status is not one of the valid statuses: 'pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', or 'cancelled'.

errors.name: InvalidQuantityError
errors.description: Raised when the quantity of an order item is not a positive integer.

errors.name: InvalidPriceError
errors.description: Rased when the price of a product is not a positive number.

errors.name: InvalidStockQuantityError
errors.description: Raised when the stock quantity of a product is not a non-negative integer.

errors.name: InvalidInvoiceNumberError
errors.description: Raised when the invoice number is not a valid alphanumeric string.

errors.name: DuplicateInvoiceNumberError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice number already exists for a customer.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to confirm an order that would result in negative stock quantities.

errors.name: InvalidCSVFormatError
errors.description: Raised when the CSV data format is malformed.

errors.name: InvalidInputError
errors.description: Raised when the input data is invalid for any reason not covered above.

errors.name: PermissionDeniedError
errors.description: Raised when an unauthorized user attempts to perform an admin operation.

errors.name: DatabaseConnectionError
errors.description: Raised when there is an issue connecting to the SQLite database.
